_about: Rough guide to Sheffield neighbourhoods for renters. Prices are indicative monthly ranges (GBP) compiled in November 2026 from public listing snapshots and SpareRoom's Q3 2026 rental index (Sheffield average room ~GBP540, bills included). They are NOT live prices - always check the live listing links. room = room in a house share, usually bills included. studio = studio or 1-bed flat, bills often extra. parking: easy | mixed | permit. students: 0 = few, 1 = some, 2 = student-heavy. Pull requests to correct or add areas are welcome.

areas.name: City Centre
areas.note: Everything walkable, best bus and tram links. Many studio blocks are students-only, and parking is scarce or paid.

areas.name: Kelham Island
areas.note: Trendy old industrial quarter with modern flats, bars and cafes. Pricier.

areas.name: Highfield / London Road
areas.note: Five minutes by bus from the centre, lots of cheap food on London Road. Many professional house shares.

areas.name: Park Hill / Norfolk Park
areas.note: Right behind the train station. Handy for trips to London or Manchester.

areas.name: Ecclesall Road / Hunters Bar
areas.note: Very liveable, Endcliffe Park, frequent buses. Busy with students near the road itself.

areas.name: Nether Edge
areas.note: Leafy, quiet and popular with professionals. Good independent food scene.

areas.name: Abbeydale Road / Sharrow
areas.note: Lively high street, quick bus into town, cinema and cafes. Good value for professionals.

areas.name: Meersbrook / Heeley
areas.note: Quiet, residential, big park with city views. Easier parking.

areas.name: Woodseats
areas.note: Local high street and supermarkets, frequent buses on Chesterfield Road. Easy parking.

areas.name: Broomhill
areas.note: University of Sheffield heartland. Lively but very student-heavy.

areas.name: Crookesmoor
areas.note: Cheap rooms close to the universities. Mostly student houses.

areas.name: Crookes
areas.note: Hilltop suburb with its own high street. Quieter than Broomhill.

areas.name: Walkley
areas.note: Up-and-coming, community feel, steep hills. Good value.

areas.name: Hillsborough
areas.note: Affordable, on the tram line, big park and leisure centre. Popular with young professionals.

areas.name: Fulwood
areas.note: Very quiet and green, close to the Peak District. Expensive and fewer rentals.

areas.name: Gleadless
areas.note: Residential, cheaper, easy parking. Buses rather than tram.

areas.name: Handsworth
areas.note: East side, quick to the M1. Quiet and residential.

areas.name: Crystal Peaks / Beighton
areas.note: Shopping centre, tram terminus, close to the M1. Suburban and calm.

areas.name: Darnall / Attercliffe
areas.note: Among the cheapest, on the tram, near Meadowhall and the M1. Mixed reputation, so view in person.
